The Business Intelligence Analyst supports Ambulatory Imaging Operations and provides system-wide analytic support for Imaging Services across all modalities, departments, and sites. Aggregates data from Strata, API, Genesys, and other source systems and builds standard and ad hoc reports and Power BI and Tableau dashboards covering productivity, volume, staffing, capacity, and financial performance. Serves as the data and analytics resource for the Imaging Services team, translating data into recommendations that support operational decisions. Partners with Finance, Revenue Cycle, and Information Services to ensure data validity and consistent metric definitions. In addition, is responsible for the accuracy and management of the Charge Data Master (CDM) (Rate Schedule) analysis and resolving billing and rate deck problems.
Must understand basic budget, billing, and cost accounting functions
